coordination._note: Rules agreed with Rishi 17 Nov 2026. See strategy/CHANNEL_COORDINATION.md in the Claude Project.
coordination.budget_is_additional: Ads money is new money. The WhatsApp autopilot keeps its own wallet and budget (INR 1,000/day). This agent never reads, lowers or reallocates it.
coordination.shared_lead_record: Leads sheet keyed by phone. Ads tag source=ctwa + ad id; WhatsApp tags source=wa_outbound + cell.
coordination.lists_uploaded: Rishi approved (17 Nov) hashed uploads of the scraped business database for targeting. Uploads run from the WhatsApp Lambda, never via this public repo (hashes of phone numbers are reversible).
coordination.joint_wave: Warm-up ads to a cell's audience 4 days before the autopilot's first WhatsApp touch, reminder CTWA ads during follow-ups, 50/50 holdout per cell to measure lift. See strategy/CHANNEL_COORDINATION.md.
